**Could not verify with a live search** — both `websearch` and `webfetch` returned `permission required but no prompt available` in this run, so I have no web-accessible results to cite from this session (and nothing cached in the local project).

Best-known canonical locations (⚠️ **unverified in this session** — the "Food Additive Status" annotations from NCATS are published as PubChem *annotations*, not as a standalone downloadable file):

- PubChem annotation source page for NCATS: `https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/source/annotation/NCATS`
- Browse/filter the annotations themselves: `https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/annotation/#source=NCATS`
- Programmatic access (PUG-REST, all NCATS annotations incl. Food Additive Status): `https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/annotations/source/NCATS/` 
- Upstream classification lists the annotations are derived from: FDA CFSAN/ORA "Food Additive Status" via OpenFDS (`https://open.fda.gov/apis/food/`) and NCATS (`https://ncats.nih.gov/`).

To confirm, re-run with web tools permitted (`allow` websearch/webfetch in `.goathome/config.json`) and check the PubChem annotation source page for the "Food Additive Status" annotation name and its dataset download link.
